## Summary

Describe the user or project outcome and the authoritative requirement or decision behind it.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant `npm run check:vN` syntax command.
- [ ] I recorded any additional review or validation performed.
- [ ] I did not describe a syntax check or prototype review as application, integration, deployment, accessibility-conformance, security, or production verification.

## Privacy and scope

- [ ] This change contains fictional data only—no real journals, photos, identifiers, credentials, private URLs, provider responses, or photo-derived descriptions.
- [ ] Real photos and photo-derived data remain outside every AI path.
- [ ] The private, single-user MVP boundary is unchanged, or an explicit product decision authorizes the change.
- [ ] Frozen prototype files are unchanged, or their affected evidence and invalidation are explicitly updated.
- [ ] The document index, tracker, and traceability matrix are updated where applicable.
